_note: ai4comms FULL documentary-warm library (2026-07-22). Builds on the locked validation batch (t1-t6 stay as each theme's first option). 3 new distinct compositions per theme (-b/-c/-d) x --variants 2 => ~8 generated frames/theme; combined with sourced stock => ~10 options/theme for the selection board. Real Dutch communications professionals, unposed, warm-neutral muted grade. NO abstract/data-texture/architectural/neon (brand anti-patterns).
